name: bind_repo
description: Bind this workstream to a git repository and check out an isolated worktree for it. Every shell command and file tool in this workstream then runs inside that checkout. Call this before setup_env and dispatch_agent. Pass 'repo' with a registered repo name, OR pass 'url' with a git URL to register and bind a repository the server has not seen before — the clone uses your own linked git credential, so a private repo you can access works. ALWAYS pass one of them: omitting both does NOT bind anything, it only reports the current binding and lists available repos.

repo.description: Name of a repo registered on this server. Pass this to actually bind. Omit ONLY when you want a read-only status report of the current binding and the available repos.

base_ref.description: Branch, tag or commit to check out from. Defaults to the repo's default branch.

url.description: Git URL to register and bind, e.g. https://github.com/org/repo.git. Use when the repository is not already registered. The name is derived from the URL unless 'repo' is also given.
